title: PILLAGERS AND YOUR TEAMMATE HOLD BIG GUNS
why: His order of 2026-10-12, second part: the bigger guns from the last build were on you only. Pillagers, hires, friendly pillagers and your teammate in this window now hold the same gun pictures at the same size, so a pillager rifle reads as a rifle and his Support MG as a Support MG across the room. Before, his pistol and SMG vanished into his red sleeve; the gun is inked and rim lit now, so it stands off any coat. Your teammate Forge gun also shows here: his state message now carries the MK and the element with the gun, so his gold finish and his element glow are drawn in your window too. Cosmetic only: nothing a fight reads changes.
now: Pillagers, hires and your teammate hold the same big guns, and a teammate Forge gun shows its finish in your window.
